question: Bahu Mela in _________ is the major festival held at the Kali Temple in the Bahu Fort twice an year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bahu Mela** is a major festival held at the **Kali Temple** in the Bahu Fort.
 
• This festival is celebrated **twice a year** in the city of **Jammu**__.
 
• The Bahu Fort is a historical fort located in Jammu, which is a significant tourist attraction.
 
• The festival is dedicated to the worship of Goddess Kali, who is also known as **Bave Wali Mata** by the locals.
 
• During the festival, the temple and its surroundings are beautifully decorated, and a large number of devotees visit to seek blessings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Jammu** is known as the **City of Temples** due to its numerous temples and shrines.
 
• The **Bahu Fort** is believed to be one of the oldest forts in Jammu, built originally by Raja Bahulochan over 3,000 years ago.
 
• The fort has undergone several renovations and reconstructions over the centuries, particularly under the reign of the Dogra rulers.
 
• Besides the Kali Temple, the Bahu Fort complex also includes beautiful gardens known as **Bagh-e-Bahu**.
 
• The festival attracts not only locals but also tourists who are interested in experiencing the rich cultural heritage of Jammu.
